mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized rate signals expanding economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1200) signals reduced consumer confidence and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized rate signals inflationary pressure that increases real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 105, it indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and consumer spending (RSAFS > 440000) signals expanding demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 440000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
